newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Vickers downgrades NOL.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Vickers downgrades NOL.

text.p: Brokerage Vickers Ballas said on Monday it had downgraded Neptune Orient Lines Ltd (NOL) to "underperform" in anticipation of weaker interim results.
Vickers said in a note to clients that NOL's interim results, due mid-September, was expected to be below market expectations of Singapore $47 million.
"Liner trade, which comprised 80 percent of its revenue, is under pressure from intense competition due to an overhang in capacity," it said.
Vickers said container vessel capacity was expected to increase by 10-15 percent per year over the next two years, but worldwide freight demand would grow by only 7-8 percent.
NOL is expected to incur operating losses of S$4.7 million in 1996, it said.

However, Vickers said NOL's bottom-line would remain in the black, boosted by profits from the sale of two 1,300 Teu container vessels for US$40 million in the first quarter. Vickers forecast a profit of S$30 million from the sale.
